title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Look in the City of Lipa
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Look in the City of Lipa
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Look tại Thành phố Lipa
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Look ในเมือง Lipa
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Look di Kota Lipa
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Look di Bandar Lipa

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1714_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Waniwani, Sayatin and Look, barrio of Balete, City of Lipa, are separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said city, to be known as the barrio of Look.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
